title: Django
blurb: Django core, the ORM, DRF, async, Celery and hardening.

quiz.question: QuerySets in Django are…
options: Lazy: the SQL runs only when the QuerySet is evaluated (iterated, sliced with a step, len(), list(), etc.)
quiz.explanation: Chaining filter()/exclude() just builds the query; evaluation hits the database, and the results are cached on that QuerySet instance.

quiz.question: Which fixes N+1 queries for a ForeignKey accessed in a loop?
quiz.explanation: select_related follows ForeignKey/OneToOne with a JOIN; prefetch_related runs a second query for many-to-many and reverse relations and joins them in Python.

quiz.question: What does F('stock') - 1 in an update() do?
options: Reads stock into Python, then writes it back
Performs the arithmetic in the database, avoiding race conditions
quiz.explanation: F expressions reference column values in SQL (UPDATE ... SET stock = stock - 1), so concurrent updates don't overwrite each other.

quiz.question: Why must you run makemigrations and commit the migration files?
options: Migrations are versioned schema changes every environment applies in the same order
They are only needed for SQLite
quiz.explanation: Migrations are code: reviewed, committed, and applied with migrate in each environment, keeping schemas consistent.

quiz.question: In Django REST Framework, where does per-object authorization belong?
options: In permission classes (has_object_permission) and queryset filtering
quiz.explanation: Filter get_queryset() to what the user may see and implement has_object_permission; otherwise users can reach other users' objects by ID (BOLA/IDOR).

problems.title: Safe stock decrement
problems.prompt: Two users buy the last item at the same time and both orders succeed. Fix the view.
problems.solution: Inside transaction.atomic(), either lock the row with Product.objects.select_for_update().get(pk=id) and check stock before decrementing, or do a conditional update: updated = Product.objects.filter(pk=id, stock__gt=0).update(stock=F('stock') - 1) and fail if updated == 0. Create the order in the same transaction.

problems.title: Paginate an API
problems.prompt: An endpoint returns 50,000 rows and times out. Fix it in DRF.
problems.solution: Enable pagination (PageNumberPagination with a max page size, or CursorPagination for large or real-time tables), order by an indexed column, select only needed fields (only()/values()), and fix N+1 queries with select_related/prefetch_related.
